name: Foamy Syncthing
author: foamrider
description: Syncthing folder and device status in the Omarchy bar, with pause, unlink and add-folder controls and Syncthing service start/stop, through a bundled native core (Syncshell 0.1.9).

barWidget.description: Monitor Syncthing folders and devices, pause, unlink or add folders, and start or stop the Syncthing user service.

schema.label: Warn when fewer devices are connected (this one included; 0 turns the warning off)
Refresh the full status every (seconds; file activity is live)
Refresh while the popup is open every (seconds)
Check the Syncthing installation and service every (seconds; only while Syncthing is offline)
